extension.description: VS Code helpers for JellyFrame app packages.
command.debug: JellyFrame: Debug App In Desktop Shell
menu.label: JellyFrame
configuration.title: JellyFrame
configuration.repoRoot: Optional JellyFrame repository root. Leave empty when running the extension from this repository.
configuration.buildDir: Optional desktop build directory. Leave empty to prefer build/Release, then build/Debug.
configuration.openCaptureAfterRun: Open the generated capture after a frame-script run when a capture is produced.
configuration.pythonPath: Python executable used to run tools/jellyframe_cli.py.
configuration.defaultTarget: Default target preset passed to JellyFrame CLI commands.
configuration.fontBudget: Default glyph budget passed to font resource checks.
